content: A constant +9.612 mm correction fitted to grasp plateau reduces its error but strongly worsens independent approach/transport/insert errors. A 45.622 ms timing correction likewise does not explain the contact plateau. Do not promote either as physical calibration.
applicability: original Piper replay, native encoder opening, residual training / grip-hold validation
limitations: Other nonlinear mappings and the retained final model were not tested
No independently measured real aperture or force
